test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given expectations is/are implicit in the statement.

Statement:

A customer can avail banking services at his/her doorstep.

Expectations:

I. This will create problems for the bank.

II. Customers would be very happy with the service.

options.text: Both expectations I and II are implicit.
Neither expectation I nor expectation II is implicit.

solution:
__**Option 1**__ is the correct answer.

**Statement:**

A customer can avail banking services at his/her doorstep.

**Expectations:**

I. This will create problems for the bank. - 

II. Customers would be very happy with the service.

⇒ II is implicit. The statement implies that one will be happy by availing banking services at his/her doorstep. Clearly, nothing is mentioned about its consequences faced by bank. So, I is not implicit

Hence, only** expectation II** is implicit.
